summary: Iter-185 — Revenue Trend (7-day) owner-PIN gating for managers on miracurl-marathahalli verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 7/7 pass: manager /reports/dashboard returns revenue_trend=[] and revenue_trend_locked=true while owner returns 7 {date, revenue} entries with revenue_trend_locked=false; GET /reports/revenue-trend → 403 OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED for manager without PIN and with wrong PIN 0000, 200 with 7 items for correct PIN 4321, 200 unconditionally for owner; toggle OFF via owner PUT /settings/revenue-lock {hide:false} (X-Owner-Pin 4321 + X-CSRF-Token from csrf_token cookie) → manager dashboard trend visible + /reports/revenue-trend 200 without PIN; restored hide:true and confirmed manager back to 403. Frontend Playwright: manager (Bangalore geo 12.9631691,77.7132717) sees [revenue-trend-card] with [revenue-trend-locked] ('Locked by the owner' + gold [revenue-trend-unlock-btn]), and [revenue-trend-stats] + [revenue-trend-range] NOT rendered. Click unlock → [owner-pin-modal], enter 4321 → [revenue-trend-locked] gone, [revenue-trend-stats] visible with 'Total Revenue' ₹11,800, Daily Average ₹1,686, Highest Day ₹7,080 (18 Sept), 3 days with billing; chart renders; toast 'Revenue Trend unlocked for this session' captured. Regression: [perf-locked] and [month-revenue-masked] BOTH still present before AND after trend unlock (independent locks). Owner (admin@miracurl.com) sees Revenue Trend chart + stats directly (locked=0, unlock_btn=0, stats=1, range=1) with the same numbers. Only 1 wrong-PIN attempt consumed (0000), well below the 5-attempt lockout. Tenant hide_month_revenue confirmed TRUE at end.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py line 191 vs 192: `locked` (month revenue) depends on hide AND (non-owner OR peek_pin), whereas `team_locked` (trend + staff perf) depends only on hide AND not owner. That is intentional (peek_pin should not affect team locks) but worth a code comment to prevent future drift.

Dashboard.jsx RevenueTrendCard (line 745): [data-testid=revenue-trend-range] uses `first && !showLock` while stats use only `!showLock` — if trend array is empty for a fresh salon, range disappears but stats still show ₹0. Minor inconsistency, cosmetic only.
Pre-existing (not from iter-185): MiraDayOffer.jsx line 55 hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' still logged in dashboard console — flagged in iter-184, unchanged.
